subject: I couldn't ran a model with R-INLA

messages.author: f2474553d6c29da6
messages.subject: I couldn't ran a model with R-INLA
parts:
Hi!
I have a dataset with disease counts for Brazil cities.
I managed to obtain the SHP file in the IBGEs site (the Brazilian bureau).

I have used the st_read function from sp package to load the shp file and joined it with the number of cases of the disease information. 
Then, I used the functions poly2nb and nb2inla to create the graph file.

So, now, I have this data:


codMunRes is the Id of the cities and numCasos the number of cases.

I tried to ran the INLA model with this formula:
formula = numCasos ~ 1 + f(codMunRes, 'bym', graph =  'outputs/file.graph') 

It didn't work. 
So, I tried to simplify the things and used simply:
formula = numCasos ~ 1 

and

mod1 = inla(formula, family = 'poisson', data = test_df).

Which returns the following error:


Any idea of what can I do?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] I couldn't ran a model with R-INLA
parts:
Try with named arguments,

 f(codMunRes, model='bym', graph =  'outputs/file.graph')

—
Haavard Rue
HelpDesk 
help@r-inla. org
